en.title: Cyclic Stress Loading Test
en.summary: Test rig and analysis for small-scale material fatigue under cyclic stress.
en.challenge: Small additively manufactured specimens needed controlled cyclic loading and repeatable data capture to investigate fatigue behavior.
contribution: Designed the loading concept and integrated motor control, fixtures, sensing, and specimen handling.
Implemented Python control and data-acquisition logic for repeatable cycles.
Processed the resulting load/cycle data and documented experimental limitations.
technical: Command logic controls the actuator and repeated loading profile.
Sensors record mechanical response while safety and stop conditions protect the setup.
Python turns raw samples into fatigue plots and comparison data.

architecture.label: Test definition
architecture.detail: Specimen, load amplitude, cycle profile, and stop conditions define the experiment.

architecture.label: Control
architecture.detail: Python commands the motor/actuator and coordinates acquisition.

architecture.label: Measurement
architecture.detail: Sensors record the mechanical response over repeated cycles.

architecture.label: Analysis
architecture.detail: Processed histories expose fatigue behavior and differences between specimens.

outcomes: Built a complete experiment from mechanical concept through control and analysis.
Combined hardware, software, and materials understanding in one project.
Created repeatable data rather than relying on manual observations alone.

zh.title: 循環應力載入試驗
zh.summary: 小型材料疲勞的循環載入試驗架設與分析。
zh.challenge: 小型積層製造試件需要受控的循環載入與可重複的資料擷取，才能研究其疲勞行為。
contribution: 設計載入概念，並整合馬達控制、夾治具、感測器與試件操作。
以 Python 實作控制與資料擷取邏輯，確保循環試驗可重複執行。
處理載荷與循環次數資料，並記錄實驗限制。
technical: 指令邏輯控制致動器與重複載入曲線。
感測器記錄機械響應，安全與停止條件則保護試驗設備。
Python 將原始取樣資料轉換為疲勞曲線與比較資料。

architecture.label: 試驗定義
architecture.detail: 以試件、載荷振幅、循環曲線與停止條件定義實驗。

architecture.label: 控制
architecture.detail: Python 控制馬達或致動器，並協調資料擷取。

architecture.label: 量測
architecture.detail: 感測器記錄多次循環下的機械響應。

architecture.label: 分析
architecture.detail: 處理後的歷程資料呈現疲勞行為與試件間差異。

outcomes: 完成從機械概念、控制到分析的整套實驗。
在同一專案中整合硬體、軟體與材料知識。
建立可重複的資料流程，不再只依賴人工觀察。
